items.title: Welcome to Kings Centre Southall News
items.content_html:
Welcome to our new space for stories and updates from Kings Centre Southall.

We’ll use this site to share news from our community, youth work, training, football academy and wider organisation.

This is an early preview while we test a simple way for our team to publish updates. For current information about our services, safeguarding and how to contact us, visit Kings Centre Southall.
